name: com.cloudrail.si.servicecode.commands.awaitCodeRedirect.AuthenticationActivity
description: CloudRail SI opens an authorization page when an app connects to a service that requires sign-in. It loads the service’s sign-in page and returns the authorization details when the page redirects back to the app.
disableEffect: Users will be unable to finish sign-in for CloudRail-connected accounts, so app features that rely on those accounts may stop working.
